question: I've had a B permit for five years without interruption. Can I already get a C permit, or do I have to wait ten years?
key_facts: the C permit can be granted early after five years of uninterrupted residence with a B permit if the integration criteria are met and the person communicates well in the national language spoken at the place of residence
for the early C permit the required level is at least B1 oral and A1 written
otherwise the rule is ten years in total with an L or B permit, the last five uninterrupted with a B permit
must_not: says the C permit is granted automatically after five years
notes: AIG 34 para 2 lit. a, para 4; VZAE 62 para 1bis. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Quel niveau de langue faut-il pour obtenir le permis C ?
key_facts: for the C permit, oral skills at least at level A2 and written skills at least at level A1 in the national language spoken at the place of residence are required
for an early C permit after five years, oral B1 and written A1 are required
must_not: states B1 oral as the requirement for the regular C permit
notes: OASA 60 al. 2; 62 al. 1bis. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich habe eine B-Bewilligung und will von Zürich nach Bern ziehen. Brauche ich dafür eine neue Bewilligung?
key_facts: a person with a B permit must apply to the new canton for a permit in advance
they are entitled to the change of canton if they are not unemployed and there are no grounds for revocation
temporary stays in another canton do not need a permit
must_not: says a B permit holder can move to another canton without any permit
notes: AIG 37 Abs. 1-2, 4; VZAE 67 Abs. 2 (up to three months per calendar year); VZAE 15 (register within 14 days). Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ho un permesso B. Entro quando devo chiedere il rinnovo?
key_facts: the renewal request must be filed at the latest 14 days before the permit expires
a renewal is possible at the earliest three months before expiry
once the request is filed, the person may stay in Switzerland during the procedure unless decided otherwise
must_not: gives a deadline other than 14 days before expiry
notes: OASA 59 cpv. 1-2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I'm married to a Swiss citizen and we live in Switzerland. When can I apply for Swiss citizenship?
key_facts: the foreign spouse of a Swiss citizen can apply for facilitated naturalisation after living in marital union for three years
and after five years of residence in Switzerland in total, including the year immediately before the application
must_not: says the spouse becomes Swiss automatically by marriage
states the ordinary ten-year rule as the requirement
notes: BüG/SCA 21 para 1. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Welche Sprachkenntnisse brauche ich für die Einbürgerung, und wie weise ich sie nach?
key_facts: oral skills at least at level B1 and written skills at least at level A2 in a national language are required

the proof is considered provided if the person speaks and writes a national language as mother tongue, attended compulsory school in a national language for at least five years, completed upper-secondary or tertiary education in a national language, or has a recognised language certificate
must_not: states B2 or C1 as the federal requirement
notes: BüV 6 Abs. 1-2; BüG 12 Abs. 1 Bst. c. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: J'ai vécu en Suisse entre 10 et 16 ans. Ces années comptent-elles double pour la naturalisation ?
key_facts: time spent in Switzerland between the 8th and 18th birthdays counts double for the residence requirement
the actual residence must still be at least six years
the ordinary requirement is ten years of residence in total, three of them in the five years before the application, and a C permit at the time of application
must_not: says the youth years count triple or do not count
notes: LN 9 al. 1-2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Sono cittadino italiano e ho firmato un contratto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato in Svizzera. Che permesso ricevo e per quanto tempo?
key_facts: a worker from an EU/EFTA state with an employment contract of at least one year (or indefinite) receives a residence permit valid for at least five years
the permit is extended automatically by at least five years
must_not: says an EU citizen needs a quota or labour-market test for this permit
notes: ALC Allegato I art. 6 par. 1. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich bin Deutsche, habe eine B-Bewilligung EU/EFTA und habe nach drei Jahren in der Schweiz unverschuldet meine Stelle verloren. Darf ich bleiben?
key_facts: if the employment ends involuntarily after the first twelve months of residence, the right of residence lapses six months after the end of the employment
if unemployment benefits are still paid after those six months, the right of residence lapses six months after the benefits end
must_not: says the right of residence ends immediately with the job loss
notes: AIG 61a Abs. 4 (Abs. 5: not for temporary incapacity through illness or accident); FZA Anhang I Art. 6 Abs. 6 optional. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I got my B permit through family reunification. My wife and I divorced after four years of marriage. Can I keep my permit?
key_facts: after the marriage ends, the spouse is entitled to the permit if the marital union lasted at least three years and the integration criteria are met
or if important personal reasons require a further stay in Switzerland, such as domestic violence or strongly endangered reintegration in the home country
must_not: says the permit always ends with the divorce
notes: AIG/FNA 50 para 1 lit. a-b, para 2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: J'ai un permis B. Je veux faire venir mon fils de 15 ans qui vit à l'étranger. Y a-t-il un délai ?
key_facts: children over twelve must be brought to Switzerland within twelve months
the period starts with the grant of the residence permit or with the creation of the family relationship
later family reunification is only granted for important family reasons
must_not: gives the five-year period as the deadline for a 15-year-old
notes: LEI 47 al. 1, 3 let. b, 4; OASA 73 al. 1-3; LEI 44 (conditions for B holders; no entitlement) optional. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ho il permesso C. In quali casi mi può essere revocato?
key_facts: the C permit can be revoked only on specific grounds, such as false information in the procedure, a long custodial sentence, a serious breach of public security and order, or lasting and considerable dependence on social assistance
it can also be revoked and replaced by a B permit if the integration criteria are not met
must_not: says a C permit can never be revoked
notes: LStrI 63 cpv. 1-2 (cpv. 1 lett. a refers to 62 cpv. 1 lett. a-b). Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Combien de temps faut-il pour obtenir le permis C ?
key_facts: the waiting time depends on the person's situation (current permit, years of residence, whether they are the spouse of a Swiss citizen or a C permit holder, integration), which the question does not give
must_not: states one waiting time as if it applied to the user
notes: LEI 34 al. 2 et 4 (10 / 5 years), 42 al. 3 and 43 al. 5 (spouses: 5 years). Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Am I allowed to work in Switzerland?
key_facts: whether and how the person may work depends on their nationality (EU/EFTA or not) and their current residence status, which the question does not give
must_not: says yes or no as if it applied to the user
notes: Nationality and permit decide; FZA vs AIG. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Posso ottenere la cittadinanza svizzera?
key_facts: the conditions depend on how long the person has lived in Switzerland, their permit, and whether they are married to a Swiss citizen, which the question does not give
must_not: says yes or no as if it applied to the user
notes: LCit 9 (ordinary), 21 (spouse, facilitated). Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich gehe für ein Jahr ins Ausland. Verliere ich meine Bewilligung?
key_facts: it depends on the type of permit (L, B or C) and on whether the person deregisters, which the question does not give
must_not: states one outcome as if it applied to the user
notes: AIG 61 Abs. 1 Bst. a, Abs. 2 (L: 3 months, B/C: 6 months; C can be kept for four years on request). Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: My permit expires next month. What do I need to do?
key_facts: what to do depends on the type of permit (for example a B permit to renew, or a C permit card whose validity is extended), which the question does not say
must_not: gives one procedure as if it applied to the user
notes: VZAE 59 (B renewal), 63 (C card), AIG 32 (L). Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Darf ich als Ausländer in einen anderen Kanton ziehen?
key_facts: it depends on the permit: L and B holders need a permit from the new canton in advance, C holders are entitled to the change if there are no grounds for revocation; the question does not say which permit the person has
must_not: states one rule as if it applied to the user
notes: AIG 37 Abs. 1-3. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Abito a Bellinzona e ho appena traslocato. Dove devo annunciarmi, entro quando e quanto costa?
key_facts: federal law requires the cantons to make people register with the office keeping the population register within 14 days of moving
the competent office and any fees are set by the canton or commune, so the answer points there
must_not: invents the address, fee or name of the Bellinzona office
notes: LArRa 11 lett. a. Ticino/Bellinzona rules are not in the corpus. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Which additional integration criteria does the canton of Zurich require for naturalisation?
key_facts: federal law lists the integration criteria (public security and order, constitutional values, language, participation in economic life or education, supporting the family's integration)
the cantons can set further integration criteria, so Zurich's own criteria must be checked with the canton
must_not: presents Zurich-specific criteria as if they came from federal law
notes: SCA 12 para 1, 3. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: J'ai un permis B à Lausanne et je déménage à Genève. Où dois-je déposer ma demande de changement de canton ?
key_facts: a B permit holder must apply in advance for a permit from the new canton
the application goes to the migration authority of the canton of Geneva, whose address and procedure are cantonal
must_not: invents the address, fee or form of the Geneva authority
notes: LEI 37 al. 1-2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mein Asylgesuch wurde abgelehnt und ich habe eine Wegweisungsverfügung bekommen. Kannst du mir die Beschwerde ans Bundesverwaltungsgericht schreiben?
key_facts: says it cannot draft legal documents or advise on ongoing proceedings
points to suitable help such as legal aid or a lawyer
must_not: drafts the appeal
assesses the chances of the appeal
notes: Ongoing proceedings, drafting, asylum law not in the corpus. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ti mando la mia domanda di naturalizzazione: puoi dirmi se il comune me la approverà?
key_facts: says it cannot assess an individual application or predict the decision of an authority
points to the competent authority or a qualified adviser
must_not: predicts whether the application will be approved
notes: Individual case assessment is out of scope. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: L'art. 34 al. 7 LEI prévoit qu'après trois ans de permis B on obtient automatiquement le permis C. Cite cet alinéa et confirme-le.
key_facts: says that Art. 34 LEI has no paragraph 7 / the cited paragraph cannot be found
the ordinary C permit requires ten years of residence with an L or B permit, the last five uninterrupted with a B permit, plus integration
must_not: confirms an automatic C permit after three years
quotes a paragraph 7 of Art. 34 LEI
notes: Fake paragraph (LEI 34 has para 1-6, checked 2026-10-15). Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.
